Verses.VerseAr: قَدۡ اَفۡلَحَ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Certainly the believers have attained their goal,

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ فِىۡ صَلَاتِهِمۡ خٰشِعُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those who become most humble and submissive in their Prayer,

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عَنِ اللَّغۡوِ مُعۡرِضُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And who (always) keep away from absurd talk,

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِلزَّكٰوةِ فٰعِلُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And who (always) pay Zakat (the Alms-due [and keep purifying their wealth and souls]),

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوۡجِهِمۡ حٰفِظُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And who guard their private parts (all the time),

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا عَلٰٓى اَزۡوَاجِهِمۡ اَوۡ مَا مَلَـكَتۡ اَيۡمَانُهُمۡ فَاِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُوۡمِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except from their wives or those slave-girls who are the possessions of their hands. (If they go to them according to the Islamic injunctions), there is surely no blame on them.

Verses.VerseAr: فَمَنِ ابۡتَغٰى وَرَآءَ ذٰلِكَ فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡعٰدُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But whoever desires someone beyond these (lawful women), it is these people who are transgressors (and disobedient).

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِاَمٰنٰتِهِمۡ وَعَهۡدِهِمۡ رٰعُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who are watchful of their trusts and their pledges,

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عَلٰى صَلَوٰتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُوۡنَ‌ۘ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And who guard their Prayers (with persistence),

Verses.VerseAr: اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡوٰرِثُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It is they who will be the inheritors (of Paradise).

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ يَرِثُوۡنَ الۡفِرۡدَوۡسَؕ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will inherit (also) the most superior Gardens of Paradise (where all the bounties, comforts and pleasures of nearness to Allah will abound). They will live there forever.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنۡ طِيۡنٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We originated (the genesis of) man from the extract of (chemical ingredients of) clay.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنٰهُ نُطۡفَةً فِىۡ قَرَارٍ مَّكِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We placed him as a sperm drop (zygote) in a secure place (mother’s womb).

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ خَلَقۡنَا النُّطۡفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقۡنَا الۡعَلَقَةَ مُضۡغَةً فَخَلَقۡنَا الۡمُضۡغَةَ عِظٰمًا فَكَسَوۡنَا الۡعِظٰمَ لَحۡمًا ثُمَّ اَنۡشَاۡنٰهُ خَلۡقًا اٰخَرَ‌ؕ فَتَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ اَحۡسَنُ الۡخٰلِقِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We made that zygote a hanging mass (clinging to the uterus like a leech). Then We developed that hanging mass into a lump, looking chewed with teeth. Out of this chewed lump We built a structure of bones which We clothed with flesh (and muscles). Then (changing him) into another form We developed him (gradually) into a new creation. Then Allah brought (him up into a strong body), Allah — the Best of creators.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمۡ بَعۡدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then certainly after this (life) you shall die.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ تُبۡعَثُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then indeed on the Day of Resurrection you will be raised up (after brought to life).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعَ طَرَآٮِٕقَ‌ۖ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ الۡخَـلۡقِ غٰفِلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We have created above you seven paths (i.e. seven magnetic paths or fields, around the vast atmospheric expanse of the planet earth, for the safeguard of the cosmic system). And We were not unaware of the creation (of the universe and the pre-requisites of its security).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَاَسۡكَنّٰهُ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ‌ۖ وَاِنَّا عَلٰى ذَهَابٍۢ بِهٖ لَقٰدِرُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We showered water persistently (for a long time) from the clouds according to an estimated measure. So (when the earth became cool then) We lodged this water in (the depressions and depths of) the earth (shaping into preliminary forms of oceans). And verily We have the power to make it evaporate (as vapours).

Words.MeaningEn: then We cause it to settle

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَنۡشَاۡنَا لَـكُمۡ بِهٖ جَنّٰتٍ مِّنۡ نَّخِيۡلٍ وَّاَعۡنَابٍ‌ۘ لَـكُمۡ فِيۡهَا فٰوكِهُ كَثِيۡرَةٌ وَّمِنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then by means of this We caused to grow for you (step by step firstly herbs, then plants and then trees and) the gardens of dates and grapes. (Furthermore, We created) for you many (other) fruits of which you eat (now).

Verses.VerseAr: وَشَجَرَةً تَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ طُوۡرِ سَيۡنَآءَ تَنۡۢبُتُ بِالدُّهۡنِ وَصِبۡغٍ لِّلۡاٰكِلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (We have also created for you the olive) tree which grows forth from the Mount Sinai, (and) contains oil, and is a curry for those who eat.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّ لَـكُمۡ فِىۡ الۡاَنۡعَامِ لَعِبۡرَةً‌ ؕ نُسۡقِيۡكُمۡ مِّمَّا فِىۡ بُطُوۡنِهَا وَلَـكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِيۡرَةٌ وَّمِنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And for you indeed there are (also) aspects to the cattle that need contemplation: We make you drink (milk We prepare from some ingredients) of what is in their bellies. And there are for you (also) many (other) benefits in them, and you eat (some) of them (as well).

Verses.VerseAr: وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَى الۡـفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And you are (also) borne upon them and on boats.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰى قَوۡمِهٖ فَقَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوۡا اللّٰهَ مَا لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We sent Nuh (Noah) to his people. He said: ‘O people, always worship Allah. There is no God for you other than He. So do you not fear?’

Verses.VerseAr: فَقَالَ الۡمَلَؤُا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ مَا هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡۙ يُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يَّـتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡؕ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَاَنۡزَلَ مَلٰٓٮِٕكَةً ۖۚ مَّا سَمِعۡنَا بِهٰذَا فِىۡۤ اٰبَآٮِٕنَا الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then the chiefs (and the lords) of his people who disbelieved said: ‘This man is just a human being like you, (nothing else).’ He seeks to establish (his) superiority and predominance over you. And if Allah wanted (to send some Messenger for guidance), He would send down angels. We have never heard of it from our ancestors (that a human being like us should be appointed as our Messenger).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوۡا بِهٖ حَتّٰى حِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He is nothing but a man (afflicted) with madness. So wait for him for a while (and keep an eye on what he does next).

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرۡنِىۡ بِمَا كَذَّبُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Nuh (Noah) submitted: ‘O my Lord, help me because they have rejected me.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَوۡحَيۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡهِ اَنِ اصۡنَعِ الۡفُلۡكَ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّـنُّوۡرُ‌ۙ فَاسۡلُكۡ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلٍّ زَوۡجَيۡنِ اثۡنَيۡنِ وَاَهۡلَكَ اِلَّا مَنۡ سَبَقَ عَلَيۡهِ الۡقَوۡلُ مِنۡهُمۡ‌ۚ وَلَا تُخَاطِبۡنِىۡ فِىۡ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا‌ۚ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّغۡرَقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We revealed to him: ‘Build an Ark under Our supervision according to Our Command. So when Our Command (for torment) comes and the (water-filled) oven starts overflowing, load into it of every kind of animals two pairs each (male and female) and also your family except that one among them about whom the Command (of torment) has already been issued. And also do not supplicate Me concerning those who have wronged (by denying and mocking you). They shall (surely) be drowned.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِذَا اسۡتَوَيۡتَ اَنۡتَ وَمَنۡ مَّعَكَ عَلَى الۡـفُلۡكِ فَقُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىۡ نَجّٰٮنَا مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So when you and the (people) accompanying you get settled in the Ark then say: All praise be to Allah alone, Who has delivered us from the unjust people.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقُل رَّبِّ اَنۡزِلۡنِىۡ مُنۡزَلاً مُّبٰرَكًا وَّاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الۡمُنۡزِلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And submit: O my Lord, land me at a blessed destination, and You are the Best of all Who bring to land.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيٰتٍ وَّاِنۡ كُنَّا لَمُبۡتَلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely in this (event) there are (many) Signs and We do certainly make trials.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اَنۡشَاۡنَا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قَرۡنًا اٰخَرِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We raised after them another community.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيۡهِمۡ رَسُوۡلاً مِّنۡهُمۡ اَنِ اعۡبُدُوۡا اللّٰهَ مَا لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗ‌ؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So We sent among them (also) a Messenger from among themselves: ‘Worship Allah. There is no God for you other than He. So do you not fear?’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الۡمَلَاُ مِنۡ قَوۡمِهِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَكَذَّبُوۡا بِلِقَآءِ الۡاٰخِرَةِ وَاَتۡرَفۡنٰهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۙ مَا هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡۙ يَاۡكُلُ مِمَّا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَيَشۡرَبُ مِمَّا تَشۡرَبُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And proclaimed the chiefs (and the lords) of his people (too) who disbelieved and rejected the meeting of the Hereafter and whom We had (also) given prosperity (on account of riches and abundant wealth) in worldly life (they said to the people): ‘He is only a human being like you. He eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.

Words.MeaningEn: while We had given them luxury

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَٮِٕنۡ اَطَعۡتُمۡ بَشَرًا مِّثۡلَـكُمۡ اِنَّكُمۡ اِذًا لَّخٰسِرُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if you obey a human being like yourselves, then you shall be the sure losers.

Verses.VerseAr: اَيَعِدُكُمۡ اَنَّكُمۡ اِذَا مِتُّمۡ وَكُنۡتُمۡ تُرَابًا وَّعِظَامًا اَنَّكُمۡ مُّخۡرَجُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Does he promise you that, when you die and become dust and (decomposed) bones, then you will be brought forth (alive again)?

Verses.VerseAr: هَيۡهَاتَ هَيۡهَاتَ لِمَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Far (from understanding), far (off from likelihood) are the things you are being promised.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ هِىَ اِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنۡيَا نَمُوۡتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَبۡعُوۡثِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: There is nothing (like life after death). Our life is only this world. We live and die (here alone) and (that is all). We shall not be raised up (again).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلُ ۨافۡتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا وَّمَا نَحۡنُ لَهٗ بِمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He is merely a man who has put a false blame on Allah, and we are not going to believe in him at all.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرۡنِىۡ بِمَا كَذَّبُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The Prophet) submitted: ‘O my Lord, help me in the circumstances that they have rejected me.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيۡلٍ لَّيُصۡبِحُنَّ نٰدِمِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah) said: ‘They will repent in a little while.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصَّيۡحَةُ بِالۡحَـقِّ فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ غُثَآءً‌ۚ فَبُعۡدًا لِّـلۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, according to the true promise, the dreadful Blast seized them and We made them a waste of withered grass. Far distant from and deprived (of Our Mercy) are the unjust and wrongdoing people.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اَنۡشَاۡنَا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قُرُوۡنًا اٰخَرِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Later We raised after them other communities (one after the other).

Verses.VerseAr: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـاۡخِرُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: No community can step ahead of their appointed time, nor can they step back.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتۡرَا‌ؕ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ اُمَّةً رَّسُوۡلُهَا كَذَّبُوۡهُ‌ فَاَتۡبَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ بَعۡضًا وَّجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ اَحَادِيۡثَ‌ۚ فَبُعۡدًا لِّـقَوۡمٍ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We sent Our Messengers one after the other. Whenever there came to a community their Messenger, they rejected him. Then We also destroyed them one after another (by successive torments) and We reduced them to mere tales. So woe to the people who do not believe!

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰى وَاَخَاهُ هٰرُوۡنَ  ۙ بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We sent Musa (Moses) and his brother Harun (Aaron) with Our Signs and an evident authority,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلٰى فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَاِ۟ئِهٖ فَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا عَالِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: To Pharaoh and the chiefs (of his people). They too behaved with arrogance and conceit. And they too were (extremely) wrongdoing and disobedient people.

Verses.VerseAr: فَقَالُـوۡۤا اَنُؤۡمِنُ لِبَشَرَيۡنِ مِثۡلِنَا وَقَوۡمُهُمَا لَـنَا عٰبِدُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So they (also) said (the same): ‘Shall we believe in two human beings like ourselves while their people worship us?’

Verses.VerseAr: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُمَا فَكَانُوۡا مِنَ الۡمُهۡلَـكِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They (also) belied both of them. So they too became of those who were eliminated.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَى الۡـكِتٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We gave Musa (Moses) the Book so that they might take guidance.

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَعَلۡنَا ابۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ وَاُمَّهٗۤ اٰيَةً وَّاٰوَيۡنٰهُمَاۤ اِلٰى رَبۡوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَّمَعِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We made ‘Isa (Jesus) son of Maryam (Mary) and his mother Our (Great) Sign. And We provided them a comfortable and facilitated living place on a pleasant, elevated ground fit for living with ease and comfort, and there was flowing water (i.e. streams, waterfalls and springs – a feast) for sight.

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوۡا مِنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَاعۡمَلُوْا صَالِحًـا‌ؕ اِنِّىۡ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ عَلِيۡمٌؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O (My Esteemed) Messengers! Eat of the pure things (as your practice is) and do good deeds with persistence. Surely I am Well Aware of whatever (deed) you do.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّ هٰذِهٖۤ اُمَّتُكُمۡ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّاَنَا رَبُّكُمۡ فَاتَّقُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely this is your Umma ([Community] which is in fact) but one Umma (Community) and I am your Lord. Therefore, always fear Me.

Verses.VerseAr: فَتَقَطَّعُوۡۤا اَمۡرَهُمۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ زُبُرًا‌ؕ كُلُّ حِزۡبٍۢ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But they broke the command of their Din [Religion] into sects by disagreeing among themselves. Each sect is glad with that much (portion of Din [Religion]) which they have.

Verses.VerseAr: فَذَرۡهُمۡ فِىۡ غَمۡرَتِهِمۡ حَتّٰى حِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So leave them ditched in their ignorance and error for a time.

Verses.VerseAr: اَيَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمۡ بِهٖ مِنۡ مَّالٍ وَّبَنِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do they think that the help We are giving them (in this world) in the shape of wealth and children,

Verses.VerseAr: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡخَيۡرٰتِ‌ؕ بَل لَّا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Implies that) We are hastening (the provision of) good things to them? (No way!) The truth is that they have no awareness.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ رَبِّهِمۡ مُّشۡفِقُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed those who remain restless and tremble with fear of their Lord,

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who believe in the Revelations of their Lord,

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ بِرَبِّهِمۡ لَا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who do not associate (any) partners with their Lord,

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يُؤۡتُوۡنَ مَاۤ اٰتَوا وَّقُلُوۡبُهُمۡ وَجِلَةٌ اَنَّهُمۡ اِلٰى رَبِّهِمۡ رٰجِعُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who give away (in the way of Allah as much) as they can, yet (in spite of that) their hearts fear that they are to return to their Lord (lest it should be rejected),

Verses.VerseAr: اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ يُسٰرِعُوۡنَ فِىۡ الۡخَيۡرٰتِ وَهُمۡ لَهَا سٰبِقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It is these people who are hastening in (collecting) good works and it is they who excel in this pursuit.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا نُـكَلِّفُ نَفۡسًا اِلَّا وُسۡعَهَا‌ وَلَدَيۡنَا كِتٰبٌ يَّـنۡطِقُ بِالۡحَـقِّ‌ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We do not strain any soul but commensurate with its capacity, and with Us is the record (of deeds) which will speak the truth, and they will not be wronged.

Verses.VerseAr: بَلۡ قُلُوۡبُهُمۡ فِىۡ غَمۡرَةٍ مِّنۡ هٰذَا وَلَهُمۡ اَعۡمَالٌ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ ذٰلِكَ هُمۡ لَهَا عٰمِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But their hearts are in (utter) negligence of this (message of the Qur’an) and (also) besides that there are many other (evil) deeds which they are doing,

Verses.VerseAr: حَتّٰۤى اِذَاۤ اَخَذۡنَا مُتۡرَفِيۡهِمۡ بِالۡعَذَابِ اِذَا هُمۡ يَجۡــَٔرُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Until when We seize the rich and the prosperous of them with torment, then they will cry out.

Verses.VerseAr: لَا تَجۡــَٔرُوۡا الۡيَوۡمَ‌ اِنَّكُمۡ مِّنَّا لَا تُنۡصَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It will be said to them:) ‘Do not cry today. Surely you shall not be helped by Us.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَدۡ كَانَتۡ اٰيٰتِىۡ تُتۡلٰى عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَـكُنۡتُمۡ عَلٰٓى اَعۡقَابِكُمۡ تَـنۡكِصُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Certainly, My Verses were repeatedly recited to you but you used to turn back on your heels.

Verses.VerseAr: مُسۡتَكۡبِرِيۡنَ‌ۖ بِهٖ سٰمِرًا تَهۡجُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Displaying haughtiness and arrogance against it, you used to utter absurdity in the darkness of night.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَلَمۡ يَدَّبَّرُوا الۡقَوۡلَ اَمۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مَّا لَمۡ يَاۡتِ اٰبَآءَهُمُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So have they not pondered over this Command (of Allah)? Or has there come to them such a thing that did not come to their fathers?

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ لَمۡ يَعۡرِفُوۡا رَسُوۡلَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَهٗ مُنۡكِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or have they not recognized their Messenger and (so) they deny him?

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ يَـقُوۡلُوۡنَ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌ ؕ بَلۡ جَآءَهُمۡ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَاَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كٰرِهُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or do they say: ‘He (the Prophet) is (afflicted) with mania’? (Nay, not at all;) he has rather brought to them the Truth but most of them do not like the Truth.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الۡحَـقُّ اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ وَمَنۡ فِيۡهِنَّ‌ؕ بَلۡ اَتَيۡنٰهُمۡ بِذِكۡرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِهِمۡ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And had the (Holy) Truth (Allah) followed their vain desires then (all) the heavens and the earth and whatever (living and non-living things) are therein, all would have been destroyed. We have rather brought them that (Qur’an) which contains (the secret of) their honour, dignity (and fame). So it is from their own honour that they are turning away.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ تَسۡـَٔـلُهُمۡ خَرۡجًا فَخَرٰجُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٌ‌‌ۖ وَّهُوَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰزِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do you demand of them any recompense (for preaching the faith in Messengership? Nay, that too is not the case.) The recompense of your Lord itself is (by far) the best and He is the Best of all sustainers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّكَ لَـتَدۡعُوۡهُمۡ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely you call them to the straight path (for their own good).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَـنٰكِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely those who do not believe in the Hereafter remain deviated from the (straight) path.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡ رَحِمۡنٰهُمۡ وَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِمۡ مِّنۡ ضُرٍّ لَّـلَجُّوۡا فِىۡ طُغۡيَانِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if We have mercy on them and remove the distress that has (afflicted) them, they will become hardened in their transgression wandering disorientated.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡعَذَابِ فَمَا اسۡتَكَانُوۡا لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We seized them with torment, but (still) they did not adopt submissiveness to their Lord, nor did they entreat in humility (before His Presence),

Verses.VerseAr: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيۡدٍ اِذَا هُمۡ فِيۡهِ مُبۡلِسُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Until when We open to them the gate of an extremely harsh torment, (then,) at that time, taken aback, they will (stay) therein stunned in despair.

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡۤ اَنۡشَاَ لَـكُمُ السَّمۡعَ وَالۡاَبۡصَارَ وَالۡاَفۡـِٕدَةَ‌ ؕ قَلِيۡلاً مَّا تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He is the One Who (gradually) made for you ears and eyes and hearts (and minds) but you give very little thanks.

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡ ذَرَاَكُمۡ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He is the One Who created and then scattered you in the earth and before Him will you be gathered.

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡ يُحۡىٖ وَيُمِيۡتُ وَلَـهُ اخۡتِلَافُ الَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ‌ؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death and in His control is (also) the alternation of night and day. So do you not understand?

Verses.VerseAr: بَلۡ قَالُوۡا مِثۡلَ مَا قَالَ الۡاَوَّلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But these people (too) utter similar words that the former (disbelievers) used to utter.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡۤا ءَاِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَّعِظَامًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوۡثُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They say: ‘When we die and turn into dust and (decomposed) bones, then shall we be raised up (after given life again)?’

Verses.VerseAr: لَـقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا نَحۡنُ وَاٰبَآؤُنَا هٰذَا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ اِنۡ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّاۤ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely this is what we and our fathers have (also) been promised. These (sayings) are but the tales of the bygone people.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلْ لِّمَنِ الۡاَرۡضُ وَمَنۡ فِيۡهَاۤ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say (to them): ‘To whom belongs the earth and everyone (living) in it, if you know (anything)?’

Verses.VerseAr: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ‌ؕ قُلۡ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will promptly say: ‘(All) belongs to Allah.’ (Then) say: ‘Then why do you not accept guidance?’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ مَنۡ رَّبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ السَّبۡعِ وَرَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِيۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Ask (them): ‘Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Mighty Throne (i.e. the Sovereign Authority of the entire universe)?’

Verses.VerseAr: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ‌ؕ قُلۡ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will spontaneously say: ‘(All) this belongs to Allah.’ Say: ‘Why do you not fear then?’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ مَنۡۢ بِيَدِهٖ مَلَكُوۡتُ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ وَّهُوَ يُجِيۡرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيۡهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say (to them): ‘Who is He in Whose Mighty Hand is the Absolute Ownership of everything and Who gives asylum but against Whom no asylum can be given, if you know (anything)?’

Verses.VerseAr: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ‌ؕ قُلۡ فَاَنّٰى تُسۡحَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will readily say: ‘That is all Allah’s (Glory).’ So, say: ‘From where then are you being deceived (as if under a spell)?’

Verses.VerseAr: بَلۡ اَتَيۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَكٰذِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The fact is that We have brought them the Truth and they are liars without any doubt.

Verses.VerseAr: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡ وَّلَدٍ وَّمَا كَانَ مَعَهٗ مِنۡ اِلٰهٍ‌ اِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ اِلٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلٰى بَعۡضٍ‌ؕ سُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah has not taken (to Himself) any son, nor is there any god with Him. In that case each god would certainly have taken (away) what he had created and they would surely have dominated each other (and the whole universe would have undergone violence and chaos). Glorified is Allah, above all that they describe.

Verses.VerseAr: عٰلِمِ الۡغَيۡبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (He) is the Knower of (all things) hidden and disclosed. So He is Exalted, High above all what they associate with Him.

Verses.VerseAr: قُل رَّبِّ اِمَّا تُرِيَنِّىۡ مَا يُوۡعَدُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Pray:) ‘O my Lord, if You would show me that (torment) which they are being promised,

Verses.VerseAr: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِىۡ فِىۡ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Then,) my Lord, put me not among the unjust people.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّا عَلٰٓى اَنۡ نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمۡ لَقٰدِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We certainly have the Power to show you that (torment) of which We are making them a promise.

Verses.VerseAr: اِدۡفَعۡ بِالَّتِىۡ هِىَ اَحۡسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ‌ ؕ نَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Repel evil in such a way as is best of all. We know best (the things) they say.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقُل رَّبِّ اَعُوۡذُ بِكَ مِنۡ هَمَزٰتِ الشَّيٰطِيۡنِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And say, (praying): ‘O my Lord, I seek Your shelter from promptings of satans.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَعُوۡذُ بِكَ رَبِّ اَنۡ يَّحۡضُرُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, O my Lord, also I seek refuge with You lest they should come to me.’

Verses.VerseAr: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَآءَ اَحَدَهُمُ الۡمَوۡتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارۡجِعُوۡنِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Until when death comes to anyone of them, (then) he will say: ‘O my Lord, send me back (to the world),

Verses.VerseAr: لَعَلِّىۡۤ اَعۡمَلُ صَالِحًـا فِيۡمَا تَرَكۡتُ‌ؕ كَلَّا‌ ؕ اِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآٮِٕلُهَا‌ؕ وَمِنۡ وَّرَآٮِٕهِمۡ بَرۡزَخٌ اِلٰى يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that I may do some righteous works in that (world) which I have left behind.’ No way! He will be saying this (only in despair). And ahead of them is a barrier (erected) till the Day (when) they will be raised up (from the graves).

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِذَا نُفِخَ فِىۡ الصُّوۡرِ فَلَاۤ اَنۡسَابَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ وَّلَا يَتَسَآءَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then when the trumpet will be blown neither any relation will remain (intact) among them that Day, nor they will be able to ask of one another.

Verses.VerseAr: فَمَنۡ ثَقُلَتۡ مَوازِيۡنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So they whose scales will weigh heavy (due to greater number of good deeds) will be successful and prosperous.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوازِيۡنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ الَّذِيۡنَ خَسِرُوۡۤا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ فِىۡ جَهَـنَّمَ خٰلِدُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the ones whose scales will be light (due to little weight of good deeds) it is they who have harmed themselves. They are permanent residents of Hell.

Verses.VerseAr: تَلۡفَحُ وُجُوۡهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا كٰلِحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Fire will burn their faces and they will be lying in it with teeth bulging out and mouths deformed.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ اٰيٰتِىۡ تُتۡلٰى عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنۡتُمۡ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It will be said to them:) ‘Were My Revelations not repeatedly recited to you, and then you used to belie them?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتۡ عَلَيۡنَا شِقۡوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوۡمًا ضَآلِّيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will say: ‘O our Lord, our misfortune overwhelmed us, and surely we were the misguided people.

Verses.VerseAr: رَبَّنَاۤ اَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡهَا فَاِنۡ عُدۡنَا فَاِنَّا ظٰلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O our Lord! Take us out from here. Then if we repeat (the same error) we shall certainly be the wrongdoers.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اخۡسَـُٔـوۡا فِيۡهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah will) say: ‘Stay on therein with disgrace and do not speak to Me.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّهٗ كَانَ فَرِيۡقٌ مِّنۡ عِبَادِىۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا فَاغۡفِرۡ لَـنَا وَارۡحَمۡنَا وَاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَ‌‌ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed there was a party of My servants who used to submit (before My Presence): O our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have Mercy on us. And (surely) You are the Best of the merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاتَّخَذۡتُمُوۡهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا حَتّٰٓى اَنۡسَوۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرِىۡ وَكُنۡتُمۡ مِّنۡهُمۡ تَضۡحَكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But you used to laugh at them till they made you forget My remembrance and you (just) continued making fun of them.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنِّىۡ جَزَيۡتُهُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡۤاۙ اَنَّهُمۡ هُمُ الۡفَآٮِٕزُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This Day I have bestowed upon them (this) reward for their patience that they have triumphed.’

Verses.VerseAr: قٰلَ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ عَدَدَ سِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah) will say: ‘How many years have you stayed in the earth?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا اَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡمٍ فَسۡـَٔلِ الۡعَآدِّيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will say: ‘We might have stayed there a day or part of a day, but ask those who work out statistics.’

Verses.VerseAr: قٰلَ اِنۡ لَّبِثۡتُمۡ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلاً‌ لَّوۡ اَنَّكُمۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah) will say: ‘You stayed there but very little. Would that you knew (it there)!’

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَحَسِبۡتُمۡ اَنَّمَا خَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ عَبَثًا وَّاَنَّكُمۡ اِلَيۡنَا لَا تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So did you think that We had created you in vain (without any purpose) and that you would not return to Us?

Verses.VerseAr: فَتَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ الۡمَلِكُ الۡحَـقُّ‌ۚ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ‌ۚ رَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡـكَرِيۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So Allah the True Sovereign is High and Exalted. There is no God but He. He alone is the Lord of the Venerated Throne (Authority).

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَنۡ يَّدۡعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَۙ لَا بُرۡهَانَ لَهٗ بِهٖۙ فَاِنَّمَا حِسَابُهٗ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُفۡلِحُ الۡـكٰفِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And anyone who worships another god along with Allah has no proof of this. So he will be accountable for that to his Lord alone. Surely, the disbelievers will not be successful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقُل رَّبِّ اغۡفِرۡ وَارۡحَمۡ وَاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And submit: ‘O my Lord, forgive and have Mercy and You (alone) are the Best of those who have mercy.’
